checks.label: If you know how much the area of the one unit square changes, it tells you how the area of any region changes: under every move in the lesson the shaded square, the shape of two squares, the shape of six and the flag all grow by one same factor, and the shapes drawn match

This number ad − bc is the determinant of A: on every screen the number shown is a times d take away b times c of the move it belongs to, and boxing a parallelogram and taking away its corners leaves the same number

A move that squishes all of space onto a line makes the area of every region zero: with j on the line of i, and under the squash among the mixed puzzles, the shaded square and the flag have no area and the number shown is zero

Whenever a move inverts the orientation of space, so the flag reads backwards, the determinant is negative: at every setting of j and on every screen, the square is hatched and the flag turned over exactly when the number is below zero

Every worked number is right: 3 × 2 = 6; 2 squares become 12, not 6 or 8; the shear keeps 1; base 2 × height 3 = 6, the slanted side gives about 6.3, the triangle 3; the box is 4 by 3 = 12, its corners take 3, 2 and 2 (7), leaving 5; [2 −1; 1 1] gives 3, not 1 or −3, and 2 squares become 6; 24 ÷ 4 = 6, not 96 or 20; j on (1, 1), (1, 0), (1, −1) gives 2, 0, −2; [1 2; 2 1] gives −3; [2 4; 1 2] gives 0, [2 4; 1 3] 2, [1 0; 0 −1] and the mirror −1; the quarter turn 1

Cut and slide keeps the area: on the shear and on the leaning parallelogram the cut triangle slides along by the base, and with the part left it fills a base by height box exactly; both screens end with the slide done
Each puzzle's answer comes from the rule, and each wrong answer offered is the slip its hint names
Each puzzle offers three different answers, accepts only the right one, and draws every wrong one in the warning colour
Before Check, no puzzle shows its answer; after a right answer, it does
Every demonstration has finished arriving within its 3 to 4.5 s, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion, right or wrong, within 2.5 s
